senses.definition: (of events) no longer planned or scheduled
below a satisfactory level
in an unpalatable state
not in operation or operational
not performing or scheduled for duties
at a distance in space or time
examples: the boat was 5 miles off (or away)
the party is still 2 weeks off (or away)

senses.definition: from a particular thing or place or position (‘forth’ is obsolete)
examples: wanted to get away from there
sent the children away to boarding school
the teacher waved the children away from the dead animal

senses.definition: no longer on or in contact or attached
kill intentionally and with premeditation
examples: The mafia boss ordered his enemies murdered

senses.definition: act in disregard of laws, rules, contracts, or promises
examples: violate the basic laws or human civilization

senses.definition: cause to feel resentment or indignation
hurt the feelings of
examples: She hurt me when she did not include me among her guests
This remark really bruised my ego

senses.definition: strike with disgust or revulsion
examples: The scandalous behavior of this married woman shocked her friends

senses.definition: a person who transgresses moral or civil law
causing anger or annoyance
causing or able to cause nausea
for the purpose of attack rather than defense
morally offensive
unpleasant or disgusting especially to the senses
violating or tending to violate or offend against
examples: violative of the principles of liberty

senses.definition: the action of attacking an enemy
a usually brief attempt
examples: he took a crack at it

senses.definition: something offered (as a proposal or bid)

senses.definition: the verbal act of offering
agree freely
examples: She volunteered to drive the old lady home

senses.definition: ask (someone) to marry you
examples: he popped the question on Sunday night

senses.definition: give something useful or necessary to
examples: We provided the room with an electrical heater

senses.definition: make available for sale
examples: The stores are offering specials on sweaters this week

senses.definition: make available; provide

senses.definition: mount or put up

present as an act of worship

examples: She offered us all a cold drink

senses.definition: produce or introduce on the stage
examples: The Shakespeare Company is offering ‘King Lear’ this month

senses.definition: propose a payment

senses.definition: put forward for consideration

examples: I offered to leave the committee if they did not accept my proposal

senses.definition: casually thoughtless or inconsiderate

senses.definition: with little or no preparation or forethought

senses.definition: in a casually inconsiderate manner

senses.definition: without previous thought or preparation

senses.definition: (of a government or government official) holding an office means being in power

during his first year in office

senses.definition: a job in an organization

senses.definition: (of winds) coming from the land

any immature animal
